issue.title: Record decisions:keep-count-is-bob-owned (bob owns the Keep count, cache, and check budget)
issue.description:
Proposed by every phase of epic bob-cli-ez (Keep → Inbox footer indicator): bob-cli-ez.1 note #1, bob-cli-ez.2 note #1, bob-cli-ez.3 note #1, bob-cli-ez.4 note #2, bob-cli-ez.5 note #1, bob-cli-ez.6 note #1. Routed by the bob-cli-ez land agent.

The epic plan (plan:202610/gkeep_footer_indicator.md) asked "Add a decisions-web record that bob owns the Keep count, its cache, and its check budget?" and the auto decision was `decision_record = no` (planner default; no human reviewed), so no phase edited memory. This task lets Bryan decide whether to record it now that the feature has shipped.

Proposed record (from the plan's keep-indicator-actions `[!decision] decision_record` callout): "Keep Count Is bob-Owned And Attention-Gated". Applies to bob-cli and bob-plugins. Claim: only bob decides when to contact Google Keep and caches the result host-locally (`${XDG_STATE_HOME}/bob-cli/gkeep/status.json`); clients run `bob gkeep status [-r]`, never poll on a fixed timer, never read the token, and never re-implement backoff (they schedule from `next_check_at`). Why: research ref `research:202610/gkeep_inbox_footer_indicator/gkeep_inbox_footer_indicator.md` plus epic commits bb3a2f41, ecffd6fa, efe2ebe0, 17702dca (bob-cli) and b0db27a, 38b9114, 48672ee (bob-plugins). Cost and reopen conditions: see the plan's Context and Risks (Google flagging token exchanges, 48/day budget, 60 s floor, rate-limit backoff Check now cannot bypass, `check_interval: off` kill switch).

Use /sase_memory_write; closing needs Bryan's explicit permission plus `sase memory init`.
